create_load_vocab: create a function that loads a vocab file into a dictionary mapping line indices to words
create_reader_generator: create a generator that reads indexed query files and resolves word indices using a vocab dictionary
build_atis_slots_data_source: build a PyText data source class that loads ATIS dataset queries and slots from CSV files
run_train_eval_test_generators: run the AtisSlotsDataSource to iterate over train, eval, and test data rows from the ATIS dataset
review_atis_slots_config: review the AtisSlotsDataSource Config class to customize filenames, validation split, and random seed parameters
